GO:0000785 chromatin is "the ordered and organized complex of DNA, protein, and sometimes RNA, that forms the chromosome" (OLS4); the definition names no taxon, so a bacterial chromosome has it in GO's sense. fact: Insulin (located in blood) raises the amount of insulin (located in blood) (part of pancreatic beta cell).
source: False as a net effect. Insulin lowers blood glucose and high blood glucose makes beta cells release insulin (the-body-s-systems-m45537-53, -200): negative feedback. The derivation takes a longer path through glucagon (-336, -201) whose signs multiply to plus. A path sign is not the net effect.
